description: Baseline v2 + readability push: shorter sentences, simpler words, to lift Flesch >=60 without losing grounding or coverage.
rules_append: READABILITY: Write for a 12-year-old reader. Keep sentences under about 15 words and put one idea in each sentence. Use everyday words; when a golf term is needed, gloss it in 2-4 words using the KB. Avoid stacking several comma clauses in one sentence.
